[[File:Bandages detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Bandages''' are a healing item that can only be obtained in [[Castle Wars]]. After the game has ended, or if the player left the game early, all bandages in a player's [[inventory]] will disappear.

Bandages are found on the table in the start room. They restore 10%{{Fact|2 April 2025 update made them scale with HP level; do these just use the anglerfish formula now?}} of a player's [[hitpoints]] (rounded down) and 30% of a player's run energy. By wearing a [[Castle wars bracelet]], the amount healed will be increased by 50%. It is possible to use bandages on other players to heal them.

On non-designed Castle Wars worlds, bandages can only heal up 18 hitpoints at a time.
